item.content:encoded:
I hope this isn't super egregious necroposting… but this tale, as it did for others, was a big ol' punch to the solar plexus of my feels.

my dad died when I was 11. it shaped my whole life. I'm still not over it. I still cry when I think of him every few days at least, and it's been 22 years. I just really miss him. we had a great relationship, but I'll just pretend that wouldn't matter (we also weren't related — he adopted my mom when he married my grandma, and then he raised me, too — but I'll pretend that that also wouldn't matter). there are so many things I'd gladly sacrifice just to hear (or in this case, see) one more sentence from him.

he spent a whole summer once reflecting and renovating an old van. he installed a loveseat and a little kitchenette. I still remember the day he proudly showed off the finished product and used the microwave in the van to heat up a mug of tomato soup for me.

348 is one of those objects that is only interesting when test logs and the like are described. (i do so wish there were more in the main article.) for that reason, I cried like a baby reading this.

I think the black queen bit might be my favorite. whatever iteration you choose to accept as canon, somewhere in even the hardest version of her heart there's still just a little kid who misses their dad. everything she did and became, it was all because of that loss. her life and path were shaped by it. I can relate to that.

good job tugging at the heart strings. 🖤

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Maybe? I did my best to write each segment so that they could be enjoyed without knowing the history behind them, with the name reveal being a kind of transition from where she goes from The Black Queen Who Is So Crafty And Clever to Alison Who Just Wants To Know If Dad Still Even Remembers Her. I don't know if that counts as her name meaning something, but that was what I was trying to do while writing it. The name wasn't what meant anything, except that she stopped being The Black Queen in that moment.

item.content:encoded:
So I got inspired and wrote a short thing about Doctor Bright and SCP 348. I showed it to some off-site folks and they liked it more than I thought they would. So I wrote another thing about 166 and 348. And they liked that too.
So I wrote a third thing with the Black Queen and 348, and then put them all together on my sandbox, and brought them to chat. Got some feedback, tweaked 'em up, but then never posted them.
But since it's an appropriate day, and I think they're about as good as they're going to get, here they all are.
I hope everyone has/is having/had a happy Father's Day. Whether it's with your dad or not.
